email.subject: Tide Pros site is likely losing mobile bookings
email.body:
Hi Luis,

I checked Tide Pros Hair Studio's site. Two things are probably costing you customers: it's not usable on mobile, which is where most salon searches happen, and there's no reviews section, so new visitors have nothing to confirm you're good before calling.

I also noticed no listed hours and a page title that doesn't say "hair salon" or "Harbor Falls," both of which hurt search visibility.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
